hook: Pulsations of a star in a binary pin down its mass at 1.594 solar masses and its companion at 1.121.
summary: Delta Scuti pulsations seen by TESS identify the primary of the binary HD 70510 and fix its mass and radius, which removes the usual inclination ambiguity of Gaia orbits. Combined with the orbit, this gives an inclination near 82 degrees and a companion of 1.121 solar masses. The intervals depend on the assumed identification of the pulsation modes and on the stellar and SED models.
title: Asteroseismology of the Gaia SB2 HD 70510: From Radial Modes to Component Masses
